name: Airbnb GitHub organization
what_it_holds: Airbnb's own public GitHub org: 204 public repositories, 5.7k org followers, verified, San Francisco. Actively updated flagship repos as of Sep 2026 include chronon (Scala ML data platform, 1,048 stars, updated 11 Sep 2026), HorizonCalendar (Swift, 3,158 stars, updated 3 Sep 2026), viaduct (Kotlin GraphQL, 173 stars, updated 12 Sep 2026), plus long-running high-star projects (javascript style guide 148k stars, lottie-android/ios ~26-36k stars). Not itself a downloadable dataset — a live org page.
why_useful: Raw source that OpenDigger / GH Archive tooling would point at to build the 'own GitHub org activity' engagement time series (gap #15); repo-update cadence and new-repo creation rate are a free, real-time proxy for engineering headcount and investment focus (e.g. chronon/viaduct being actively pushed suggests current data-platform and GraphQL infra investment).
